summary: The candidate is correct. Positive-level metronoid graph convexity sends every barycentric source selection to the full-mass target metronoid, hence to the target fiber centroid singleton. The accepted barycentric-core depth theorem and weighted lattice centerpoint theorem then give the stated pointwise and partition bounds, with all positivity, compactness, lower-dimensional affine-hull, zero-total-mass, and halfspace boundary cases handled.
